models.description: Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor Free through OpenCode Zen's Responses route. Measured 2026-09-10/11 against POST https://opencode.ai/zen/v1/responses for this exact model: a function tool carrying strict:true whose required omits an optional property is refused HTTP 400 and the identical schema without the flag returns 200, so this route drops the flag; any named tool_choice is refused because only "auto" is accepted, hence requestProfile auto-tool-choice; an input carrying a completed web_search_call is accepted and answered, hence supportsSearchHistory; a web_search tool is executed for real, returning web_search_call items with live queries and their results, hence searchTool standalone; and a tool whose parameters reference themselves through $ref is refused HTTP 400 while the same tool flattened returns 200, hence toolSchemaRecursion flatten. Context 1048576 and the reasoning ladder come from public models.dev metadata checked 2026-09-08 and are not independently verified. Prompts and completions may train Meta models; prior conversation and tool output can be included.
